utme_subjects: and any of Government, History, Geography, Literature in English, French and CRS/IRS
olevel_requirement: Five (5) SSC credit passes to include English Language, Mathematics, Economics and at least two (2) other relevant subjects from Commerce, Government and Accounting.
direct_entry: ND/NCE with upper/merit credit in the relevant programme in addition to five (5) credit passes at SSC at not more than two (2) sittings.

institution_waivers.note: Direct Entry candidates must obtain a pass in Two A/L Subjects one of which must be Economics, Accounting, Business Management, Government or Geography from GCE A/L, IJMB or Advanced NABTEB or a Merit pass at NCE Level or at least a credit in OND/HND in relevant fields. Candidates must also satisfy the O/L requirement for admission. UTME: Accepts Five (5) credits at not more than two sittings including English Language, Mathematics and Economics and any two from: Commerce/Financial Accounting, Business Methods/Insurance/Book Keeping, Government/History/Civic Education, Literature in English, Geography, and Statistics (SSCE, NECO, NABTEB or equivalent).

In addition to meeting the UTME Entry Requirements; 2 A' Level Passes in Economics & any one of Mathematics, Statistics, Geography, Financial Accounts, Business Management, History and Government; IJMB minimum of 10 points with passes in relevant subjects; NCE Credit pass in 2 NCE teaching subjects including Economics; ND upper credit in Dip. in Accounts, Business Administration, Marketing & Banking & Finance (not more than 5 yrs); HND lower credit in same (not more than 5 yrs); Degree (Third Class) in relevant courses from any recognized institution. UTME: Accepts Five SSC credit passes to include English Language, Mathematics, Economics and any two of Arts or Social Science subjects.

Accepts Two 'A' Level passes in Economics and any of History/Government, Science, Social Science and Management subjects or Credit passes at NCE or ND or IJMB with at least 9 points in relevant subjects. UTME: Requires Five credit passes at SSCE (or its equivalent) in English, Mathematics, Economics and two other relevant subjects preferable in Commerce, Government and Accounting.

Accepts a) Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Economics and any one (1) of Mathematics, Statistics, Geography, Physics, Chemistry, Agricultural Science, Accounting, Business Management, History and Government; b) ND credit in the relevant programme in addition to five (5) 'O' Level credit passes including English Language and Mathematics at not more than two (2) sittings. UTME: Accepts any two (2) Arts or Social Science subjects as the fourth (4th) and fifth (5th) subjects.
